author: 0_Error_0
body:
Use potions or spells to give yourself:
Attack++
Magic+
Whichever damage you use.
Use panacea to remove damage and defence debuffs.
Get the dragoon class for the Gait of Thrud (it should unlock for all classes).
Also can get berserk+,++,+++ from some consumables that will majorly boost all stats, but you will have to manage your health loss.

author: Drunkturtle7
body: Have in mind that if you're in a party with people within 25 levels of yours you are sharing exp (ie they're taking a percentage of the exp you earn, so you earn less) unless they haven't logged in a long time. So keeping a party that doesn't contribute may be conterproductive.
